# TEM APPAREL PTE. LTD.

> Vertically integrated apparel manufacturer with 16+ own factories across China, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar and Egypt — down jackets, padded outerwear, jackets, shirts, PU and knitwear for international brands.

TEM APPAREL develops and manufactures apparel for international brands: fabric development, design and sampling, bulk production, quality assurance and shipment — all inside the group. There are no trading middlemen between the brand and the sewing floor.

## What we make

- Down jackets and padded outerwear
- Trench coats, bombers, parkas
- Shirts and jackets
- PU and faux-leather outerwear
- Knitwear and cashmere
- Yarn and fabric development (in-house research institute)

## Manufacturing footprint

- 16+ self-owned factories; 5 production countries: China, Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Egypt
- 4 design centres: Hangzhou (core, fabric-led), Spain, Paris, New York
- Two company-owned plants in Cambodia documented in detail on this site:
  - S-YOLO (Cambodia) Garments Co., Ltd. — Kampot province. 12,564 m², 9 lines (25 planned), 600 staff (1,600 planned), 70,000 pcs/month (180,000 planned). SMETA, WRAP, SLCP, Nike audits.
  - SHCA Garment (Cambodia) Co., Ltd. — Kampong Speu province. 12,480 m², 12 lines, 800+ staff, 1,000,000 pcs/year. WRAP, SMETA 4-pillar, GRS.

## Research & development

- Sampling room: about 5,000 samples a year, 80% first-fit pass rate.
- Own tooling: zipper set on a template machine (+30% output, one operator fewer, patented); redeveloped seam machine (+30% output, no skilled operator required); in-house template fixtures.
- Design: 3D sampling and AI-assisted pattern and tech-pack work.
- Fabric: cashmere (eco, functional, special) and animal fibres (merino, mohair, alpaca); 30K/30K waterproof-breathable; PFC-free water repellency; +30 °C photothermal lining.
- Laboratory run with SGS: dimensional stability, tensile and tear strength, colour fastness, yarn strength, conditioning.

## Sustainability

- Early adopter in China; green industrial chain in place since 2022.
- Committed to the Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi); GHG reduction targets verified by SBTi.
- ZDHC compliance — zero discharge of hazardous chemicals.
- Waterless dyeing, PFC-free finishing, recycled polyester traced from bottle flake to yarn.
- 21 certifications held: GOTS, OEKO-TEX Standard 100, BCI, OCS, RWS, RMS, RAS, The Good Cashmere Standard, ICCAW, GRS, RCS, Higg Index, ICS, amfori BSCI, SMETA, WRAP, TÜV SÜD, ISO 14001 and others.

## Social responsibility

- 1,400+ people across the two Cambodian plants; 70% of the workforce are women.
- Audited by SMETA 4-pillar, WRAP, SLCP and GRS; customer audits completed for Nike, Levi's, Under Armour, Costco, U.S. Polo Assn. and Lacoste.
- Community programmes: relief for the 2023 earthquake in Turkey and the 2025 earthquake in Myanmar; the group's ongoing "World · Love · Peace" programme.
